Initial release: skill to sync Simplified-Chinese articles (zh-hans) to Traditional-Chinese (zh-hant) using OpenCC with strict safety and repo conventions.

- Converts a named Simplified-Chinese article (`docs/<YYMMDD-slug>-zh-hans.md`) to a Traditional twin (`docs/<YYMMDD-slug>-zh-hant.md`) on explicit user command only.
- Enforces approval gates: never overwrites or acts without user confirmation; never runs automatically.
- Ensures both files carry a permanent cross-link and maintain naming/file conventions.
- Uses OpenCC `s2twp` (Taiwan, phrase-aware) for accurate conversion, with a process for reporting and patching conversion edge cases.
- Includes verification and error-handling procedures to keep files in sync and prevent accidental drift or loss.
